module.description: Mandatory fuzzing module. One of: DICT, FINGER, FTP, HTTP, HTTP_MORE, HTTP_SP, HTTP_WEBDAV, IMAP, IRC, LPD, NNTP, PJL, POP, PROXY, RTSP, SMTP, SOCKS4, SOCKS5, TFTP, WHOIS

health_check_interval.description: Execute health check after every N fuzz cases. Use 0 or omit to disable.

port.description: Port to connect to. Use 0 or omit to use module-specific default.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait after each test.

resume_index.description: Start fuzzing at test case index (1-based). Use 0 or omit to start from 1.

keep_alive.description: Keep trying until server passes a health check.

dump_test_case.description: Dump current test case to stdout (use only with -r).

max_cases.description: Exit after executing this many fuzz cases. Use 0 or omit to run indefinitely.

module_args.description: List of additional per-module command-line arguments. Each item is a string passed as-is to doona.
